inspect.pack.summary: Compose bounded inspection-safe readonly services in one pinned CAD invocation, reporting partial and unsupported reads explicitly.

inputs.reads: 1..100 distinct {id,operation,data,fields?}. fields selects 1..32 top-level result keys. Only catalog inspectionSafe readonly Python services execute; other operations return unsupported.
inputs.maxItems: Maximum entries per array/object, integer 1..1000, default 100.
inputs.maxStringBytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per string, integer 16..8192, default 2048.
inputs.maxBytes: Maximum serialized result bytes, integer 1024..1048576, default 65536. Status rows may be omitted with omittedReads under tiny budgets.

limitations: Implementation checkpoint: the current shared strict checker rejects the actual full generated runtime, even with verified SDK definitions. A positive pack admission is not yet delivered; fake composition tests do not establish a working checked execution path.
Shares the canonical catalog inventory, handler registry, CadContext and prepared-artifact bundler; never runs Node coordinators, recursive packs or mutations.

Bounds output, not the work of existing native inspection services. A projection is not a geometry pass. Missing fields, truncation, unsupported services and individual errors remain explicit; later reads continue.
One SDK turn through the existing broker, with unchanged identity, source hashes and checker admission. No live Fusion qualification or performance guarantee.
